=== OUTBOX account= recipients=primary@example.com ntfy=// reason=this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit
Dedup: acctchange|primary@example.com|primary@example.com|added the rego ABC123 (Van)|email|primary@example.com
Subject: Someone made a change to your p.stonn account

added the rego ABC123 (Van)

If you expected this change, you don’t need to do anything.
If you did not, open the Activity page in p.stonn, which lists every change and who made it. You can see who has shared access under Settings.

https://p.stonn.org/activity
